# Product Configurator

> 3D Product Configurator built with React Three Fiber, Next.js, and Zustand.

## Overview
This application provides a highly interactive 3D configurator for various products like watches, mountain bikes, guitars, and keyboards. 

## Key Features
- 3D model visualization
- Exploded view and part labeling
- Customizable colors and textures

## Technical Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei)
- Zustand (State management)
- Tailwind CSS
